title: Third Shot Drop Drill (Michelle Grogan)
style: sung pop-folk groove 100 bpm warm acoustic guitar finger snaps melodic bass mellow horn light Spanish phrase accent patient swing-feel pickleball training song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
From the baseline far away
Third shot drop is how you play
Low to high low to high paddle face open
Arc it soft into the kitchen golden

[Pre-Chorus]
Drop drop drop drop
Knees bend paddle stop
Drop drop drop drop
Float it to the top

[Chorus]
This is the third shot drop
Float it slow let it stop
Drop drop drop drop bend and lift the seam
Drop drop drop drop trust the dream trust the dream

[Verse 2]
Contact out front contact out front low
Follow through gentle let it flow
Apex over the net then it falls
Into the kitchen between the walls

[Bridge]
Move your feet to the line
Split step every time
Drop and follow drop and follow
The rally is yours to borrow

[Outro]
Drop drop drop float it slow
Drop drop drop steady go
